name: Muramite Citadel: Sanctum
summary: The ceremonial and strategic sanctum where Muramite officers gather before entering deeper Citadel chambers.
description: The Sanctum is the ceremonial heart of the Interior Citadel. Muramite officers meet here to receive orders, ascenders gather before vertical deployments, and inquisitors maintain discipline through ritualized oversight. The chamber is lined with Discord‑reinforced banners, fortified alcoves, and a central sanctum dais where command rites are performed. Though not as arcane as the Heart of Discord, the Sanctum hums with disciplined energy and military precision.
